label: Episode 27
logline: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.

CLIP: episode 27, 1 segment(s), 36s
[00:44.50-00:46.40] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate): "What is your husband's name?"
[00:46.40-00:48.30] SOUND: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
[00:46.50-00:48.80] CAMERA: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
[00:48.80-00:51.50] ACTION: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
[00:48.80-00:51.50] CAMERA: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
[00:51.50-00:55.60] CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.
[00:52.20-00:55.60] LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory): "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"
[00:55.60-00:58.60] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.
[00:56.80-00:58.40] JULIANA (Calm, Defiant): "She needed help."
[00:58.60-01:02.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.
[01:00.00-01:01.80] LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious): "What are you hiding?"
[01:02.00-01:04.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.
[01:02.20-01:03.50] JULIANA (Firm): "Nothing."
[01:04.00-01:06.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.
[01:04.80-01:06.40] LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh): "Show me your hand."
[01:06.50-01:10.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.
[01:06.60-01:10.10] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative): "Girl. Show me what you are holding."
[01:10.50-01:13.80] CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.
[01:12.60-01:13.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical): "What is this?"
[01:13.80-01:14.80] JULIANA (Steady): "Medicine."
[01:14.80-01:17.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.
[01:15.20-01:17.80] LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending): "Medicine? You are a new maid."
[01:17.80-01:20.75] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.
[01:18.10-01:20.50] LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing): "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"

[01:18.10-01:20.50] LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing): "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
[01:20.80-01:23.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.
[01:21.00-01:22.00] JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute): "No one."
[01:23.00-01:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.
[01:23.60-01:26.40] LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant): "Then you administered it without permission."
[01:26.50-01:28.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.
[01:26.50-01:27.80] JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent): "Because she was dying!"
[01:28.00-01:32.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.
[01:28.20-01:32.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating): "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
[01:32.80-01:35.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.
[01:33.30-01:34.90] JULIANA (Fierce): "The physicians were not saving her!"
[01:35.00-01:37.80] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.
[01:35.30-01:37.70] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Measured, Menacing): "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
[01:37.80-01:43.60] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
[01:38.80-01:43.40] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening): "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
[01:43.60-01:47.80] CAMERA: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.
[01:44.20-01:47.50] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Contemptuous): "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
[01:47.80-01:50.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.
[01:48.30-01:49.80] JULIANA (Unyielding): "It is an antidote."
[01:50.20-01:52.05] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.
[01:50.30-01:51.80] LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative): "An antidote to what?"
